reference.name: Freeplane
reference.inspection: Bundle Info.plist=1.13.3 and gitinfo match pinned commit. Official bundled runtime launched with isolated /tmp profile and original synthetic fixture; log reached MindMap mode. Native inspection returned cgWindowNotFound. No live shortcut/drag parity is claimed.

modifier_policy: Primary=Command macOS, Control Windows/Linux. Official accelerator manager converts ordinary control chords to meta with explicit Alt/Tab/Escape exceptions. Cmd+Space remains host-reserved: Fold children has an explicit Commands entry, no silent Ctrl substitution.

reserved.meaning: Freeplane clone; not reassigned to duplicate

editor_contract: F2 edits; Alt+Enter uses the same plain multiline ordinary editor. Enter commits, Shift+Enter inserts newline, Escape cancels. Marked composition owns Enter/Escape. Native text clipboard is separate from structured branch clipboard.
known_differences: Full live reference key-repeat, selection direction, page navigation, branch-drag hit zones and side-dependent level parity await an inspectable reference UI.
Root folding is a local extension used by the large fixture.
Alt+Enter uses inline ordinary text controls rather than a separate Freeplane dialog.
Structured branch clipboard is application-local; it does not promise interprocess Freeplane clipboard compatibility.
Notes show/focus share the metadata editor; rich note/HTML formatting is excluded.

Home/End/Page navigation and Shift+Left/Right aliases are implemented from the reference listener inventory; page selection uses the local published viewport geometry. Exact live parity remains unverified.
